notes: Read both targets and full context. Resolve the incidents, killer and nine victims to the Charleston AME Church murders, and regimes to apartheid South Africa and white-ruled Rhodesia. Preserve Black Lives Matter's attributed argument and DSA's endorsement, rather than silently changing the speaker.

claims.claim_text: DSA endorses Black Lives Matter's argument that racist attacks such as the Charleston AME Church murders form part of a centuries-long pattern of white violence against Black people, rather than isolated acts by deranged individuals.
The pattern of white violence against Black people includes physical coercion alongside economic and social exclusion.
The confessed Charleston AME Church killer wore jackets with patches from apartheid South Africa and white-ruled Rhodesia, now Zimbabwe.
Apartheid South Africa and white-ruled Rhodesia were founded to maintain racist ideology, white control of the economy and domination of Black labor.
Condemnation of the murder of nine people at Charleston's AME Church.
Condemnation of politicians, commentators and others perpetuating injustice who refuse to acknowledge the Charleston AME Church murders as an act of racist terror.
Support for everyone, especially white people, to fight racial injustice.
Support for everyone to help stop racist attacks and murders against African Americans.
